conflicts.quote: On an **LLM-produced trade** recommendation that shows at least one **stated** plan field among the six and at least one grounding clause on stop / target / invalidation, the plan section shows **exactly one** section-level caption stating that the plan fields are not checked.
conflicts.why: As a ship-blocking presence rule this encodes field-content heuristics (stated plan value + risk clause present). That is architect Options B and C: a scope caption that vanishes when all six plan fields are absence literals, or when no risk clause rendered, teaches the wrong lesson (absence of caption ≠ full check coverage) and couples plan chrome to figure state. The residual is structural on every non-local_rules produced trade whose plan section mounts — including fully bare plan rows and trades without a rendered clause. UX already names the same failure mode. AC-1 may describe a rich fixture for review, but it must not define the show predicate.
conflicts.proposal: Ship-blocking presence is structural only: produced trade path with plan section mounted and `grounding.card !== 'local_rules'` (or equivalent affirmative local-rules exclusion). Optional richer fixtures (stated field + clause) may document the wrong-trade story for review without becoming gate conditions.

conflicts.quote: On a **local-rules / keyless trade** recommendation (including one with stated structure / entry trigger / confidence and empty or absent strikes/expiration), the plan-scope caption is **absent** — zero instances on the card and on any open analysis surface.
conflicts.why: Equating the exclusion path with **keyless** is a false mechanism. Live local-rules envelopes can carry a real `key_source` (observed `grounding.card: "local_rules"` with `key_source: "shared_admin"`). Gating on keyless/`key_source` either leaves standing chrome on non-none local-rules trades or over-hides model recs. The closed FE discriminator already on the wire is `rec.grounding?.card === 'local_rules'`, not payment provenance. UX pins the same field.
conflicts.proposal: Rewrite AC-2 (and path-rule language) as absence when `grounding.card === 'local_rules'`, with an explicit test fixture that pairs that card token with a non-`none` `key_source` and still expects zero caption. Drop **keyless** as a synonym for the producer path.

conflicts.quote: On an **LLM-produced trade** recommendation that shows at least one **stated** plan field among the six and at least one grounding clause on stop / target / invalidation, the plan section shows **exactly one** section-level caption stating that the plan fields are not checked.
conflicts.why: This AC turns a permanent scope boundary into a content heuristic: the caption vanishes when every plan field is absent-literal or when no risk clause rendered, teaching 'no caption means full check coverage' and re-opening the residual on fully stated unchecked plans. Architect Option A and UX's unconditional model-path rule match the product rule I already stated — scope statement, not diagnosis of the dangerous configuration. The stated-field + risk-clause case remains the critical residual fixture, not the show predicate.
conflicts.proposal: Ship-blocking presence AC: on every produced non-local_rules trade whose plan section is mounted, exactly one plan-scope caption is present stating the plan fields are not checked — independent of which plan fields are bare and independent of whether a risk/exit clause rendered this cycle.

conflicts.quote: On a **local-rules / keyless trade** recommendation (including one with stated structure / entry trigger / confidence and empty or absent strikes/expiration), the plan-scope caption is **absent** — zero instances on the card and on any open analysis surface.
conflicts.why: Slash-equating local-rules with keyless invites the false key_source exclusion architect and UX both reject: live local_rules envelopes can carry a real key_source (e.g. shared_admin). Product requires no standing chrome on the local_rules path; the already-on-wire affirmative signal is grounding.card === local_rules, not key resolution.
conflicts.proposal: AC-2 absence: on a produced trade with grounding.card === local_rules (including stated structure / entry trigger / confidence and empty or absent strikes/expiration, regardless of key_source), the plan-scope caption is absent — zero instances on the card and on any open analysis surface. Do not treat key_source alone as the exclusion.

conflicts.quote: On an **LLM-produced trade** recommendation that shows at least one **stated** plan field among the six and at least one grounding clause on stop / target / invalidation, the plan section shows **exactly one** section-level caption stating that the plan fields are not checked.
conflicts.why: This AC encodes two content heuristics as the show condition: ≥1 stated plan field and ≥1 risk/exit grounding clause. A scope boundary that vanishes when every plan field is `not given`, or when risk clauses are absent this cycle, teaches the wrong lesson (no caption ≠ full check coverage) and reopens the residual on fully-stated unchecked plans without clauses. Architect Option A and UX default/show matrix gate only on produced trade + plan section mounted + not `grounding.card === 'local_rules'`.
conflicts.proposal: Keep the stated-field + clause case as the primary ship-blocking *fixture* for presence tests; drop both content clauses from the visibility predicate so the caption is unconditional on every non-local_rules produced trade whose plan section mounts.

conflicts.quote: It must **not** become standing chrome on the **local-rules / keyless** path — that path still emits a trade with stated structure / trigger / confidence whenever a setup exists, so an always-on banner there is permanent noise and was the exact condition that cut this caption on line-budget last time.
conflicts.why: Equating local-rules with keyless points implementers at `key_source` (own_key / shared_admin / none). Architect verified live local-rules envelopes can carry a real key_source (e.g. `grounding.card: "local_rules"` with `key_source: "shared_admin"`). Gating on keyless either leaves standing chrome on rules trades with a key or hides the caption on legitimate model-path trades.
conflicts.proposal: Name the exclusion only as the closed affirmative token `grounding.card === 'local_rules'` (and rewrite AC-2 the same way). Do not treat `key_source === 'none'` as a synonym or alternate gate.

conflicts.quote: When plan-field values are visible to the trader, the caption is present on that same surface/section (a reader does not have to open a second surface solely to learn the plan fields are unchecked).
conflicts.why: Read literally, the main clause requires a caption on every surface that shows plan fields. AnalysisSurface already re-states a subset of plan labels; card-only placement (UX + architect preference) then fails the clause whenever the drawer is open, while dual attachment collides with PM's single-instance rule and re-opens the line-budget cut. The parenthetical is the real product rule (anti drawer-only); the absolute main clause over-specifies.
conflicts.proposal: Bind AC-7 to the primary act surface: the pinned plan row on DecisionCard carries the one caption so a reader never opens analysis solely for the scope fact. Analysis may re-state plan fields without a second `plan-fields-not-checked` instance.
